reel.caption:
Buying ELSS for tax in the new regime: how much tax does it save?

The ELSS deduction (old section 80C, now section 123 of the Income-tax Act, 2025) is up to ₹1.5 lakh a year, shared with PPF, EPF, life insurance and others.
It is available only in the old tax regime. In the new regime, ELSS reduces your taxable income by ₹0.
In the old regime at the 30% slab, the full ₹1.5 lakh saves an illustrative ₹45,000 before cess. ELSS also has a 3-year lock-in on each instalment.

Which regime did you pick this year?
Send this to the colleague buying ELSS for tax proofs.

Sources: a tax-law publisher's explainer on ELSS under section 123 (₹1.5 lakh, old regime only, 3-year lock-in) and a lender's investment guide on old vs new regime (no ELSS deduction in the new regime); 30% × ₹1,50,000 = ₹45,000 calculated.
